text:
mara: Seeing sustained queue growth on reserved-eu-north-1 since ~09:12 UTC, admission control is tripping and we're spilling to hosted.
aj: Confirmed. 90% of the pool GPU tokens are in use, backlog 800ish requests over 2m window.
linh: Any recent rollouts to that pool? last deploy was 03:00 UTC, no config changes.
ops-lead: Rolling autoscaler had a failed scale-up due to quota error, might be related. ops-lead: I just saw quotaX limit hit in cloud console.
mara: Can someone run pool metrics? infra-bot: running infractl command
infra-bot: `infractl pool-stats --pool reserved-eu-north-1 --since 15m` -> avg_util 0.92, queue_len 820, admit_rate 18rps, configured_capacity 80gpus
aj: admit_rate 18rps vs expected 40rps threshold. Admission controller dropping non-priority requests, customers seeing 429-like responses.
linh: Logs show many long-lived sessions with sequence lengths > 4k, those are eating up KV cache and slot time.
mara: Could we short-circuit heavy sessions to a quantized model variant to free capacity? ops-lead: We can patch routing policy to prefer q4 models for non-enterprise tenants, yes.
aj: Patch suggestion: route tenant tiers [free, dev] to q4f fallback and reserve q8 for enterprise. Low risk if we limit to non-SLA.
ops-lead: Doing a quick canary: applying policy to 10% of traffic now.
sre-bot: deploy started by ops-lead at 09:21 UTC, canary=10%
mara: Monitoring queue after canary...
infra-bot: After 3m canary: queue_len -> 640, avg_util -> 0.89, admit_rate -> 22rps. Improvement but still high.
linh: We should also evict stale warm sessions older than 12m. Policy allows eviction for non-enterprise.
aj: Eviction queued, running now: `infractl session-prune --pool reserved-eu-north-1 --max-age 720s --dry-run=false`
infra-bot: prune complete: evicted 340 sessions, reclaimed ~12 GPU-tokens.
mara: Good. queue_len -> 360, admit_rate -> 30rps. Still short of 40rps but trending better.
ops-lead: Cost note: if we spin up temporary burst nodes in eu-west to drain, it'll add ~ $1.2k/hr. Want approval?
aj: Approve emergency burst for 2 hours to recover SLOs, coordinate migration of in-flight requests.
ops-lead: Provisioning burst nodes now, will ringfence for enterprise-only to reduce cost.
sre-bot: burst provision complete at 09:33 UTC: +12 gpus from burst-pool-eu-west
infra-bot: After burst: avg_util 0.78, queue_len 40, admit_rate 39rps. SLOs almost recovered.
mara: Follow-ups: (1) audit why autoscaler failed on quotaX, (2) add automatic quantized fallback policy for non-SLA traffic, (3) tighten warm session TTLs, (4) run cost impact review for burst strategy.
linh: I'll take (1) and (2).
aj: I'll handle (3) and cost calc for (4).
ops-lead: Filing a post-incident ticket and tagging impacted tenants. ops-lead: moving thread to postmortems once summary is drafted.
mara: Thanks team. Will keep monitoring for 1h and then close incident if stable. :thumbsup:
